Html:
Hi,

I am new to Spec# and I have problem using Linq in spec# project, it does not recognize it although I am using the System.linq refernce. 

Does Spec# supports Linq?

Thanks,

Adnan

Hello Adnan,

Welcome to Spec#!  The Spec# language is a superset of C# version 2.0, which did not have the LINQ features (not the syntax and not the extension methods that LINQ uses).  So, unfortunately, you will not be able to use LINQ with Spec#.

  Rustan
